Q_Linear.name: Query Projection (W_q)
Q_Linear.desc: Query linear projection across 16 layers (2048 -> 32*64 = 2048, ~8.39 MB weights). 4x larger than K or V due to GQA.
Q_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~8.39 MB weights per layer)

K_Linear.name: Key Projection (W_k)
K_Linear.desc: Key linear projection across 16 layers (2048 -> 8*64 = 512, ~2.10 MB weights, GQA 4:1 ratio)
K_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~2.10 MB weights per layer)

V_Linear.name: Value Projection (W_v)
V_Linear.desc: Value linear projection across 16 layers (2048 -> 8*64 = 512, ~2.10 MB weights, GQA 4:1 ratio)
V_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~2.10 MB weights per layer)

FFN_Gate_Up_Linear.name: FFN Gate & Up Projections
FFN_Gate_Up_Linear.desc: SwiGLU gate_proj & up_proj matrix multiplications across 16 layers (2048 -> 8192, ~67.11 MB weights)
FFN_Gate_Up_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~67.11 MB weights per layer)

FFN_Down_Linear.name: FFN Down Projection
FFN_Down_Linear.desc: SwiGLU down_proj matrix multiplication across 16 layers (8192 -> 2048, ~33.55 MB weights)
FFN_Down_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~33.55 MB weights per layer)

LM_Head.name: LM Head Unembedding
LM_Head.desc: Linear projection from hidden dimension 2048 to 128,256 vocabulary logits (~525.3 MB weights)
LM_Head.scaling: Flat (Streams ~525 MB vocabulary weights for final token slice)

QKV_Linear.name: Combined Q, K, V Projections
QKV_Linear.desc: Combined Query, Key, and Value linear projections across 16 layers (~12.58 MB weights per layer)

O_Linear.name: Attention Output Projection
O_Linear.desc: Multi-head attention output projection across 16 layers (2048 -> 2048, ~8.39 MB weights)
O_Linear.scaling: Flat (Memory-bandwidth bound streaming ~8.39 MB weights per layer)

KV_Cache_Update.name: In-Place KV Cache Slice Insertion
KV_Cache_Update.desc: Writing newly projected key and value vectors into pre-allocated contiguous GPU cache tensors at start_pos:start_pos+1 across 16 layers.
KV_Cache_Update.scaling: Flat O(1) in-place slice assignment (~0.035 ms, zero dynamic reallocation).

Attn_Compute.name: Causal Attention Vector-Matrix Dot-Product (KV Cache)
Attn_Compute.desc: Single-token query vector dot product against cached key and value vectors across 16 layers (Q * K_cache^T / sqrt(d), softmax, P * V_cache). Ch 3 cache, past tokens are read from memory rather than recomputed.
Attn_Compute.scaling: Linear O(t) scaling with context length (233.5× faster than Chapter 2 PyTorch quadratic recomputation at step 2047)

RoPE.name: Rotary Position Embedding
RoPE.desc: Rotary position embedding (complex rotations applied to query and key vectors across 16 layers)

RMSNorm_FFN.name: Pre-FFN RMSNorm
RMSNorm_FFN.desc: Root-mean-square normalization preceding feed-forward blocks across 16 layers

RMSNorm_Final.name: Final Model RMSNorm
RMSNorm_Final.desc: Final root-mean-square normalization applied to hidden states before LM head

FFN_SiLU_Mul.name: SiLU Activation & Gating
FFN_SiLU_Mul.desc: Elementwise SiLU(gate) * up gating vector multiplication across 16 layers

Sampling.name: Token Sampling & Sync Barrier
Sampling.desc: Greedy argmax / multinomial distribution sampling and blocking next_token.item() DtoH sync

Tokenizer_Decode.name: Tokenizer Detokenization
Tokenizer_Decode.desc: CPU HuggingFace BPE token ID to UTF-8 string detokenization
